title: Shop by brand

sourcesRead.contributes: the whole requirement: six bullets under "What we need" (L20-L25), out-of-scope notes (L27, L29)

context: Marketing wants people to be able to shop by brand (story.md#L17). The brand search is for the mobile app (story.md#L24). The story has no acceptance-criteria section: the bullets under "What we need" are the criteria.

acceptanceCriteria.quote: the shop page has a "By brand" filter listing the brands; ticking one shows only that brand's products
acceptanceCriteria.text: The shop page has a "By brand" filter listing the brands; ticking one shows only that brand's products.
outcomes: the shop page has a filter "By brand" that lists the brands
after ticking one brand, every product shown is a product of that brand

acceptanceCriteria.quote: the catalogue API supports the same: GET /products?by_brand=<brand id> → only products of that brand
acceptanceCriteria.text: The catalogue API supports the same: GET /products?by_brand=<brand id> returns only products of that brand.
outcomes: GET /products?by_brand=<brand id> answers only products of that brand

acceptanceCriteria.quote: GET /brands → all brands, each with its id, name and slug
acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /brands returns all brands, each with its id, name and slug.
outcomes: each brand in the answer has its id, name and slug

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /brands/{id} returns that brand. An unknown id returns 404.
outcomes: GET /brands/{id} with the id of an existing brand answers that brand

acceptanceCriteria.quote: brand search for the mobile app: GET /brands/search?q=<text> finds brands whose name contains the text anywhere in the name, ignoring case (e.g. "craft" finds MightyCraft Hardware, "FORGE" finds ForgeFlex Tools)
acceptanceCriteria.text: Brand search for the mobile app: GET /brands/search?q=<text> finds brands whose name contains the text anywhere in the name, ignoring case (e.g. "craft" finds MightyCraft Hardware, "FORGE" finds ForgeFlex Tools).
outcomes: GET /brands/search?q=<text> finds the brands whose name contains the text anywhere in the name, ignoring case

acceptanceCriteria.text: A brand search with no match returns an empty list, still with 200.
outcomes: a search text no brand name contains → empty list

endpoints.success: all brands, each with its id, name and slug
the brands whose name contains the text, ignoring case; no match: empty list, still 200 (L25)

testData.strategy: not stated in the sources: the criteria only read the existing catalogue (brands and products)
constraints: the brands MightyCraft Hardware and ForgeFlex Tools exist in the catalogue (story.md#L24)
brand create/edit for admins is TOOL-12 and is not tested here (story.md#L29)

outOfScope: nice to have (not this sprint): brand logos, brand landing pages
FYI brand create/edit for admins is TOOL-12, don't test that here.

gaps.element: the shop page's route, how the "By brand" filter and its brand entries are found and ticked, and how a shown product's brand is told

tried.result: L20 names the shop page and the "By brand" filter, but no route, locator or how a product's brand shows

The shop page is the home page (/). Its filters column shows a level-4 heading "By brand:" (with a trailing colon) followed by a checkbox group "Brands" with one checkbox per brand, labelled with the brand's name (getByRole('checkbox', { name, exact: true })). Ticking one reloads the list (a QUERY /products call with by_brand=<brand id>). A product card (a[data-test=product-<id>], href /product/<id>) shows no brand: a shown product's brand is read from GET /products/{id}, field brand.name.

gaps.element: where a product's brand is in the GET /products answer (field name, list shape) so that "only products of that brand" can be checked

tried.result: L21 gives the method, path and by_brand parameter, not the answer's shape
GET /products answers a paginated object {current_page, data: [...], from, last_page, per_page, to, total}; each product in data has its brand nested as brand: {id, name}. Further pages with ?page=N.

gaps.value: GET /products answers a paginated object {current_page, data: [...], from, last_page, per_page, to, total}; each product in data has its brand nested as brand: {id, name}. Further pages with ?page=N.

gaps.element: the success status of GET /products?by_brand=<brand id>, GET /brands and GET /brands/{id}: no source states one (L25's "still 200" is said of the brand search)

tried.result: L21-L23 state the content of the answers only

gaps.element: which brands "all brands" (L22) and "listing the brands" (L20) means: no source lists the brands, and none says whether the filter must list the same brands GET /brands answers. Only MightyCraft Hardware and ForgeFlex Tools are named (L24)

tried.result: L20 and L22 name no brands and no count; L24 names two brands as search examples

gaps.element: what "no match" (L25) applies to: the bullet follows the brand search (L24), so it is read as a brand search no brand name matches. Whether GET /products?by_brand with a brand that has no products, or with an unknown brand id, also answers an empty list with 200 is not stated

tried.result: L25 is a separate bullet directly under the brand search bullet (L24) and names no endpoint

gaps.value: L25 applies to GET /brands/search: a search text no brand name contains answers an empty list with 200. Nothing is expected of GET /products?by_brand for a brand without products or an unknown brand id

gaps.element: what a brand id looks like, to send an id no brand has (AC-4's unknown id)

tried.result: L22-L23 say brands have an id, not its form
A brand id is a 26-character ULID string; an id of the same length, all zeros but a final 1, belongs to no brand.

gaps.value: A brand id is a 26-character ULID string; an id of the same length, all zeros but a final 1, belongs to no brand.

gaps.element: whether the brand and product endpoints need a sign-in, and how a call proves it

tried.result: L21-L25 state no protection; the pack's configuration shows no sign-in header
No sign-in: GET /brands, GET /brands/{id}, GET /brands/search?q= and GET /products?by_brand= answer without any credentials (no Authorization header, no cookie).

gaps.value: No sign-in: GET /brands, GET /brands/{id}, GET /brands/search?q= and GET /products?by_brand= answer without any credentials (no Authorization header, no cookie).
